jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager Building & Infrastructure (m/f/d) / Engineering (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Project Manager Building & Infrastructure Projects (m/f/d), you will be responsible for the management of demanding technical building, infrastructure, laboratory and production-related projects within Group Real Estate Management - Engineering. You will ensure structured preparation, professional management and successful implementation across all project phases. In this key role, you will combine technical understanding, project management expertise and stakeholder orientation in an international and regulated environment.

In this position, you will actively shape challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects on the Group side and represent Fresenius' interests vis-à-vis internal stakeholders, external project partners, service providers, landlords, authorities, and experts. You will work at the interface of real estate engineering, business units, site organisations, facility management, technical functions and external partners and contribute to shaping professional delivery governance as well as the establishment and further development of GREM-Engineering for technically oriented real estate projects.

Your responsibilities:

- Managing technically oriented building, infrastructure, laboratory and production-related projects as owner’s representative from requirements clarification to handover
- Compilation and clarification of project requirements from business units, location organisations, transaction management, facility management and strategic real estate requirements in a structured manner
- Build resilient project set-ups with scope, budget, schedule, roles, responsibilities, decision-making paths, escalation paths, and reporting logic
- Professionally manage projects through approval, planning, procurement, construction, commissioning support and handover
- Coordinating and managing architects, specialist planners, engineering service providers, project managers, construction partners, general contractors and technical specialists
- Ensure costs, deadlines, quality, scope, compliance, technical functionality, sustainability and operator requirements
- Establish and maintain schedules, budget and forecast structures, risk and opportunity registers as well as change management as central project control instruments
- Prepare status reports, management updates, steering committee documents as well as decision and escalation templates
- Ensure orderly mechanical completion, acceptance, claims management, commissioning, documentation and operator handover
- Further develop standards, methods, templates, quality gates and lessons learned for Building & Infrastructure Projects

Your qualifications:

- Master’s degree in the field of process engineering, civil engineering, architecture, building technology or a comparable qualification
- At least ten years of experience in project management of technical projects, ideally in pharmaceutical, R&D, life science, building infrastructure or comparable regulated environments
- Strong experience as an owner's representative or client-side project manager
- Very good understanding of approval planning, design & construction, commissioning and handover processes in regulated GxP areas
- Solid competence in cost, deadline, risk, claim and change management
- Broad understanding of technical building equipment, infrastructure, user requirements and operability
- Experience in managing external planners, engineering companies, consultants, construction partners and technical service providers
- Strong management competence for complex interfaces between business, sites, operating organisations, engineering, facility management, HSE, IT and external project partners
- Experience in international or matrix-oriented organisations as well as a structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working; combined with the willingness to actively shape the development, professionalisation and further development of GREM-Engineering
- Very good knowledge of German and English, both written and spoken

Why this role is exciting:

In this position, you will actively shape challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects on the Group side and represent Fresenius' interests vis-à-vis internal stakeholders, external project partners, service providers, landlords, authorities, and experts. You will work at the interface of real estate engineering, business units, site organisations, facility management, technical functions and external partners and contribute to shaping professional delivery governance as well as the establishment and further development of GREM-Engineering for technically oriented real estate projects.

Design challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects at Fresenius with technical standards, a clear project structure and a high level of implementation expertise – become part of #futurefresenius and apply now via our online portal.

Join us and experience a true partnership in innovation – working hand-in-hand to achieve our customer goals.

- Regulatory Compliance: Identification, investigation, and GAP analysis of international regulatory requirements for medical devices

- Educational background: Completed technical degree in a relevant field such as medical technology, engineering, computer science, or physics

- Technical expertise: Strong understanding of complex systems involving mechanics, software, and hardware

- Soft skills: Excellent communication skills and a strong team player mindset
- Working style: Self-driven, structured, and results-oriented approach to work
- Analytical abilities: Strong analytical thinking and confident decision-making capabilities
- Language skills: Fluency in English (spoken and written); German skills are a plus

What we offer: 

- A diversified and challenging environment combined with a high degree of freedom for the implementation of innovative ideas
- A permanent employment contract with performance-related pay at an international and promising employer
- A modern workplace in spacious and bright offices in the heart of Hamburg with a view of the River Elbe
- A supportive working atmosphere in a dynamic team with short decision paths
- An individually tailored “on the job” training and professional development opportunities
- Personal added values such as a company pension scheme, team events, employee discounts, bike leasing and much more

Join us in shaping the future of healthcare by ensuring the safety and reliability of life-saving medical devices — your expertise in risk management can make a real difference. Please send your application to application@dmed-healthcare.com or click “Apply for job.

We are looking forward to meeting you!

jobs.occupation: PhD Student (m/w/d) (Physiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Max-Planck-Institut für Struktur und Dynamik der Materie
jobs.description:
The International Max Planck Research School for Ultrafast Imaging and Structural Dynamics in Hamburg, Germany, offers a structured PhD program focusing on ultra-fast phenomena, X-ray physics and dynamical imaging in all areas of science, covering physics, chemistry and biology.

23 Interdisciplinary doctoral PhD projects in the fields of Ultrafast Science and Quantum Materials The program offers exciting research opportunities at ultra-intense electron and X-ray sources to directly observe atomic motions during primary events. The use of ultrafast imaging over the relevant length and time scales generates new levels of understanding of the interplay between structure and dynamics. Specific areas include the theoretical and experimental aspects of quantum materials and atomically resolved dynamics, fundamental light-matter interaction, accelerator-based light sources, coherent controlled molecular and solid-state dynamics, molecular imaging, extreme timescale spectroscopy, ultrafast optics and X-ray science.
We seek applicants with an excellent academic background. You hold (or are about to complete) an MSc degree or equivalent in physics, chemistry or related areas. You need to be passionate about research in ultrafast phenomena and motivated to conduct rigorous scientific work over the full degree period.

A range of PhD positions in these areas: open positions

State-of-the-art research facilities on an extensive science campus
Cross-disciplinary research in a vibrant, international scientific environment
First class supervision and mentorship by a team of internationally renowned experts
Outstanding training in your scientific subject and transferable skills (in English)
A 3-year employment contract based on the German federal pay agreement

jobs.description:

Job description

In order to support the integration of AI in Operations Investment decisions, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Master student (d/f/m) in the field of Investment Management

title of thesis: Generative AI & Process Automation in Industrial & Strategic Investment/CapEx Decisions

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of an Investment Manager in Industrial Operations? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the central Capex Management department as a master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: Q1 2027
- Duration: 6 months

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

As-Is Process Mapping:

- Assess the current state of the end-to-end CapEx dossier creation lifecycle across operational sites. You will have a close exchange with the results of the VS (Value Stream Assessments) results.

Optimisation Analysis:

- Pinpoint bottlenecks, redundant reporting between local presentations and our enterprise CapEx Planning Tool (CPT), and root causes in heavy 27-slide dossiers

Solution Design:

- Outline proposed improvements by architecting an intake and generation pipeline connecting Google Drive, Gemini AI, and Google Slides to condense content into a decision-oriented 7-slide format and and integrate “investment intelligence”, e.g. benchmarking or cost referentials.
- Design, test, and calibrate prompt or similar tools workflows for Gemini to synthesize executive summaries, risk matrices, and multi-year cash phasing projections.

Pilot Case:

- Test your approach by running 1 to 3 live industrial investment dossiers through the automated pipeline.

Performance Comparison & AI Compliance:

- Evaluate KPI improvements (As-Is vs. To-Be), measuring administrative time savings and controller approval speeds and general compliance.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled fulltime in the final year of a Master’s degree (Bac+5 / MSc) in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems (with strong business/operations interest), Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related dual engineering/business program.
- Technical Mindset: Strong interest in Generative AI prompting, workflow automation, and low-code integration (e.g., Google Workspace ecosystem, Apps Script / Python, API interactions).
- Business & Financial Curiosity: Comfortable understanding operational investment concepts (CapEx vs. OpEx, cash phasing, business cases, ROI/NPV logic).
- Communication & Change Leadership: Strong interpersonal skills to interface smoothly with diverse stakeholders (from shop-floor industrial engineers to financial controllers).
- Language Proficiency: Negotiation-level fluency in English (working language). Knowledge of French, German, or Spanish is an asset.
